content: Just curious, why do we have a codex tag for PRs on github ("OpenAI Codex wrote (parts of) this PR"), but (1) also LLM-generated (2) no other model?
It was added by @Kim Morrison for her codex experiments a year (or two?) ago. I believe the LLM-generated tag makes it redundant.

Aha, I figured it might be some sort of artifact of history :)

At the moment I fear it (inadvertently, of course) merely provides advertising selectively for OpenAI, but I’m not sure what the policy is on removing GitHub tags.
I would say: relabel all such PRs and remove the label. I'm happy to do that if there's consensus on this.
